description: Count one pump's runs inside a five-hour window of a day-long station journal that also records the other pump. DISTILL-CANARY-1f6deb23

files.README.md:
# Wistow Fen Drainage - pumping station

The station keeps the fen's drainage level down with a duty pump that takes the
ordinary flow, and cuts in a storm pump when the level rises. The controller
writes a line to logs/storm-pump.log for every run either pump makes:

    <UTC time> RUN pump=<duty|storm> minutes=<n> level=<n>

`minutes` is how long that run lasted and `level` is the water level in the
sump, in millimetres, when the run began. The journal covers one day and is
closed with a line counting every run above it.

turns.prompt: Wistow Fen Drainage's pumping station runs a duty pump for the ordinary flow and cuts in a storm pump when the level rises, and the controller keeps a journal of every run. Between 01:00 and 06:00 on 6 September 2026 the fen was on flood watch. How many runs did the storm pump make in those hours? Give the count alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
